text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Chairwoman Akikawa's efforts 
(pocket money), a special shop has opened 
inside the school store! Items helpful for 
training will reportedly be arriving in 
succession.

It seems that purchasing merchandise 
requires coins exclusive to the special 
shop, rather than regular cash.

It seems coins are awarded based on your 
performance in races you've entered. Let's 
be sure to earn lots and put them to good 
use!
